requirements.quote: A test that only asserts "this literal exists" is a weak guard.
Breaking it is a review note, not a park.
Behavioural tests (inputs → outputs) stay strong guards.
One decision deletes a named mechanism together with its weak guards.
A repo can declare areas whose changes must show a before/after measurement on recorded real inputs (a replay corpus, production samples), not only mocks.
Post-deploy checks for those areas are metrics with a baseline, not string matches.
New heuristics (keyword or regex classifiers) ship with negative examples, not only positive ones.
The guard gate labels pure exact-text guards as weak and doesn't park on them.
A removal lane deleting a mechanism and its weak guards needs one amendment.
A lane touching a declared outcome-evidence area without a before/after result fails validation, with a clear reason.

deliverables.change: New pure isWeakGuardTest(source, path): weak only when the file reads file text, imports no local non-test module, has >=1 assertion and every assertion is a literal-presence form (JS/TS assert.match/doesNotMatch/ok(x.includes), expect().toContain/toMatch; py `assert "lit" in x`, re.search); any other assertion makes it strong.

Weak fixtures (string includes, regex match on readFileSync text), strong fixtures (calls an imported function, mixed file, equality on a computed value), py cases, negative examples for the classifier itself.

materialize/runGuards tag each run with weak (classifier over the base body); guardFailures excludes weak runs; new exported weakGuardNotes(runs); supersededIds also returns guards retired by a mechanism amendment (lane deleted all their test files).
Weak failing guard gives a note and zero failures; strong failing guard still guard_broken; mechanism-retired ids reach supersededIds.

supersedes amendment with {mechanism, why} validated and stored as contract.mechanisms; precheck retires guard_broken rows whose test is in removedPaths when a mechanism row exists; precheck accepts outcomeEvidenceFailures and pushes them.
Mechanism amendment validation, retirement of deleted-test guards, a strong guard with a surviving test still fails, one amendment retires many.

New: parseOutcomeEvidenceConfig(forge.yaml outcome_evidence {paths:{area:globs}, corpus:{area:globs}}) (null when absent); outcomeEvidenceFailures({cfg, files, result, exists, checks, contract}) returning conformance.unimplemented rows of kind outcome_evidence_missing|invalid|regressed|baseline_missing, each with a clear reason naming the area, files and the required result shape.
Config parse; untouched area passes; touched area with no row, bad corpus, non-numeric values, worse after, or a post-deploy check lacking baseline each fail with a reason; a good row passes.

Accept outcomeEvidenceConfig option; call outcomeEvidenceFailures beside docsFailures and pass to precheck; in guardGate emit a guard_weak event and push weak notes to T.decisions; compute removedPaths when a mechanism amendment exists; extend the supersession comment loop to mechanism-retired guards.
readEnvConfig parses forge.yaml outcome_evidence via parseOutcomeEvidenceConfig and returns outcomeEvidenceConfig, passed to the lean engine like docsConfig.

Builder rule line: a new keyword or regex classifier ships negative examples (inputs it must not match); document the mechanism supersedes amendment and the result.outcome_evidence row shape beside the supersedes line (:268).
Wiring tests: a weak failing guard does not block the lane and is noted; a declared outcome-evidence area without a result row blocks; the prompt carries the negative-examples rule.
Document outcome_evidence (paths, corpus), the result.outcome_evidence row, the post-deploy check baseline field, weak guards and the mechanism supersedes amendment.
Dated entry for #5752 and update the Guard gate section (weak/strong, mechanism supersedes, outcome evidence).

preserve.what: A strong (behavioural) failing guard still produces conformance.guard_broken and is retired only by a per-guard supersedes or a mechanism whose lane deleted its test (bin/lean/guardgate.mjs guardFailures, bin/lean/conformance.mjs:1197).
Baseline comparison #4968, batching #5436 and the skip semantics of runGuards for non-weak guards (bin/lean/guardgate.mjs:141-236).
Repos without forge.yaml outcome_evidence see no new check (off-by-default pattern of bin/lean/docsgate.mjs:23).
Existing amendment kinds and the per-guard supersedes row with GUARD_ID_RE (bin/lean/conformance.mjs:651,802).
The OUTCOME_CODES set and docs/OUTCOME-CODES.md parity: no new code (bin/engine/outcome-codes.mjs).

validate.command: node --test --test-concurrency=2 bin/lean/weakguard.test.mjs bin/lean/outcomeevidence.test.mjs bin/lean/guardgate.test.mjs bin/lean/guards.test.mjs bin/lean/conformance.test.mjs

regression.covers: sibling guard and decision gates that share conformance.mjs precheck

decisions.choice: Reuse conformance.unimplemented for outcome-evidence failures instead of a new outcome code
decisions.justification: bin/lean/docsgate.mjs:76 does the same; a new code needs docs/OUTCOME-CODES.md parity

decisions.choice: Weak classification is deterministic source analysis of the base test body, not an LLM call
decisions.justification: NORTHSTAR non-negotiables 1 and 2; the body is already read at guardgate.mjs materialize (:213-218)

decisions.choice: Mechanism supersedes retires only guards whose test files the lane deleted; surviving strong guards still need a per-guard supersedes
decisions.justification: keeps behavioural guards strong (R3, P1) while one decision removes a mechanism; removedPaths exists at conformance.mjs:1123

decisions.choice: forge.yaml outcome_evidence uses two 2-deep maps (paths, corpus) so the existing parseForgeYaml reader suffices
Negative-examples rule is a builder prompt line only (layer 2), no deterministic check
decisions.justification: NORTHSTAR: never put a reasoning problem in a grep; a new classifier is not exactly detectable by script
